name: IndexToast – WordPress Indexing on Autopilot
author: indextoast

sections.description:
IndexToast is the secure connector between WordPress and your hosted IndexToast account. It progressively syncs public URL metadata, automatically sends new and updated publishing events, and keeps the connection healthy. Manage URL inventory, visibility checks, submissions, usage, and multiple websites together at app.indextoast.com.

“Submitted,” “processed,” and “indexed” are separate states. IndexToast does not promise search-engine inclusion or ranking.

External services

IndexToast connects to the IndexToast hosted service only after an administrator chooses to connect the website. The service provides secure website connection, submission processing, status reconciliation, technical preflight checks, and account-based allowances that cannot be performed by the plugin alone.

When a site is connected, the plugin sends the public website domain, public content URLs, content identifiers, content type, title, event time, and the minimal plugin diagnostics needed to provide the service. It does not send post bodies, passwords, drafts, private posts, or password-protected content.

Service terms: https://indextoast.com/terms

Privacy policy: https://indextoast.com/privacy

Privacy

The service and data disclosure are described above under “External services.” IndexToast uses data only to provide the selected account service, including secure connection, indexing submission, status reconciliation, and technical preflight checks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the indextoast folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP.
  2. Activate IndexToast.
  3. Open IndexToast in WordPress admin.
  4. Select “Connect this website” and approve the domain in your account.
